definitions: To decrease in price or amount.
To be passed on from an earlier time.
To travel from a higher place to a lower one, often from north to south.
To make a decision or judgment.
To be ill with something, especially after being healthy.
examples: House prices are expected to come down.
This tradition has come down through generations.
She's coming down from Scotland next week.
The judge came down hard on the defendant.
He's come down with a bad cold.
